_comment: Everything other apps can reach in the FINAL merged manifest, and every permission, must be listed here. A reachable component is acceptable only if the app needs it from outside AND (where a guard is named) the system-only permission that restricts it to the OS is present. Enforced by tools/manifest-exports.py in CI.

reachable_components.name: io.github.geniusdevam.vpnapp.QuickTileService
reachable_components.why: Quick Settings tile; only the system can bind it

reachable_components.name: de.blinkt.openvpn.core.OpenVPNService
reachable_components.why: the VPN service; only the system can bind it

reachable_components.name: de.blinkt.openvpn.core.keepVPNAlive
reachable_components.why: JobScheduler callback; only the system can bind it

reachable_components.name: androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstallReceiver
reachable_components.why: AndroidX baseline-profile hook; DUMP is held only by adb/system

_permission_notes.android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE: required by upstream's persisted keepVPNAlive job; removing it crashes the VPN process (emulator run 27)
